nextEarnings.note: Q3 2026 was reported 2026-11-10; next (Q4/FY2026) date not located

price.note: Volume of ~14,484,661 shares vs a 30-day average of ~4,520,173 (rvol approximate).

catalysts.headline: PEPG closed at $5.26, up 14.1%, on volume of ~14.5M shares versus a ~4.5M 30-day average
catalysts.impact: Stock rallied in the session(s) following the Phase 2 data/earnings release

catalysts.headline: PEPG shares continued higher the day after the DM1 data release, with heavy call-option volume reported by MarketBeat

PepGen's lead candidate (PGN-EDO51, Duchenne muscular dystrophy program) reported to have achieved the highest splicing correction yet seen in its mid-stage trial, per aggregator coverage; underlying primary source (company release / trial data) not independently located this session.

PepGen announced positive Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 10 mg/kg cohort results for PGN-EDODM1 in myotonic dystrophy type 1, reporting the highest reported splicing correction (mean 46.5%) and improvements across multiple functional measures
catalysts.impact: Positive clinical readout for the company's lead program

catalysts.headline: PepGen reported Q3 2026 financial results: net loss of $19.4M (-$0.28/share) vs an $18.0M loss (-$0.52/share) a year earlier; cash and marketable securities of $104.8M as of 2026-09-30, extending the runway into 2028
catalysts.impact: Earnings released alongside positive clinical data

catalysts.headline: PepGen reported positive topline results from the 10 mg/kg multiple-ascending-dose (MAD) cohort of the ongoing Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 study of PGN-EDODM1 in myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1), showing 46.5% mean splicing correction versus 6.8% for placebo; an independent data safety monitoring board had previously recommended advancing to the next (12.5 mg/kg) cohort with no protocol changes after reviewing available safety data
catalysts.impact: Stock surged; reported intraday/closing moves for Nov 10, 2026 range from approximately +92.9% (close of $4.61 vs. prior close $2.39) to as much as +126.6% to +146% at various points in the session (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: PepGen reported topline results from the lowest-dose (5 mg/kg) MAD cohort of the Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 study: PGN-EDODM1 generally well tolerated (no SAEs, no treatment-related discontinuations); mean splicing correction of 7.3% (n=6) vs. 6.8% placebo (n=2), with one outlier patient worsening to 70.8% pulling down the average (ex-outlier mean 22.9%, n=5); no meaningful improvement in 10-meter walk/run test or handgrip strength at this dose; vHOT (video hand-opening time) showed a positive trend in the treated group vs. worsening in placebo, both returning to baseline by Week 16

conflicts: Partial clinical hold status: one source describes the FREEDOM2 trial as under a partial U.S. clinical hold limiting enrollment at U.S. sites; this was not mentioned in the Q3 2026 earnings coverage reviewed here, so its current (as of 2026-11-13) status is unconfirmed.

Cash-runway framing: one older source cites a '$117 million runway' figure (apparently from an earlier quarter) versus the Q3 2026 release's $104.8M cash/marketable-securities figure as of 2026-09-30 — likely different points in time rather than a true contradiction, but the two should not be used interchangeably.
Market cap figure ($188.39M) is dated 2026-10-23, before the stock's rally to $5.26 on 2026-11-11, so it understates the company's market cap relative to the current share price.
notes: Single-asset biotech (PGN-EDODM1) — near-term value is highly dependent on the FREEDOM2 DM1 readouts; the next data point (12.5 mg/kg cohort) is expected in 1H 2027.
